title.en: Hybrid Retrieval with BM25 and Dense Embeddings

hook: Lexical and semantic retrieval fail on opposite query distributions. Hybrid retrieval with reciprocal rank fusion does not interpolate, it votes - and the vote wins on every query class.
prerequisites: 06 (RAG); Phase 19 Track B foundations (lessons 20-29); Phase 19 lesson 64 (chunking strategies)
